case_title: ONNX Runtime malformed Reshape initializer causes a native null-write fault
disposition: Closed by MSRC: not a security vulnerability under Microsoft criteria and below the servicing threshold; no bounty, no CVE, no further MSRC tracking.
scope: Historical evidence only. No model, library binary, or executable reproduction harness is distributed in this pack. No retesting was performed for publication.
transformation: The original absolute local research-directory prefix was replaced with <research-root>. All other text, including historical comments, native exception values, addresses and instructions, was retained. Filenames were changed as mapped below; files are UTF-8 without BOM.
hash_note: Original source SHA-256 hashes identify the archived files before redaction. They do not equal the published sanitized-file hashes. Published SHA-256 hashes identify the downloadable files.

dll_identity.qualification: Acquisition build is not the harness host OS. A version string does not establish an upstream affected range. DLL is not included.

model_identity.qualification: Hash and size identify the archived malformed model. Model is not included.

host_environment.established: x64 Windows; Python with ctypes; exact DLL/model identified in native logs
host_environment.not_established: The supplied ONNX-006 native captures do not record an exact host Windows build or Python version.

limitations: Native stack entries were found by a raw stack scan, not a complete unwound stack.
The stdout files show ctypes converting the native fault to an OSError that escapes the harness. Universal process termination is not established.
Original controls and the 5/5 claim are historical research-note assertions; this pack contains two native captures, not five.
The valid int64_data control in the original harness also included Transpose; it was not a single-variable graph comparison.
The evidence does not establish arbitrary write, code execution, privilege escalation, or a security boundary crossing.
MSRC final disposition supersedes the original report classification; an engineering-awareness referral is not acceptance of a security finding.
